title: Be Strong in the Lord
opening: Biblical spiritual strength comes from depending on the Lord, praying, standing in truth, and living with righteousness—not from pride or intimidation.
points: Put on the full armour of God by choosing truth and righteousness.
Pray consistently and remain alert to the needs of others.
Use spiritual strength to serve, encourage, and stand firm in what is right.
reflection: Which part of God’s armour do you need to remember most today?
prayer: Lord, strengthen me in Your might. Teach me to stand in truth, walk in righteousness, and serve others with humility. Amen.
ministry: Grace Fire Deliverance Healing Global Word Ministry
